mindtraced_atomic_units: Create a module implementing 8 D flip-flops.
Each flip-flop has an active-high synchronous reset.
The reset initializes the output to the binary value 0x34.
The flip-flops sample the input data on the negative edge of the clock signal.
The module interface includes a clock input (clk).
The module interface includes an 8-bit data input (d).
The module interface includes a reset signal (reset).
The module interface includes an 8-bit output (q).
